solution: The speech system takes audio-derived features, whereas the missing-word system takes a representation of written context. Their outputs are a recognized command/category and a proposed word respectively. Both learn complex patterns from training data; biased or unrepresentative examples can produce incorrect predictions, so an output should not be treated as guaranteed understanding.
